_comment: The Supabase ledger keys on the 14-digit version prefix, so two migrations
sharing one means the second is recorded as already applied and silently
skipped. A NEW collision fails CI; an entry here that no longer collides also
fails, so this list can only get shorter.
20260724180000 — crm_lead_notes and qbo_attachments. Both were applied long
before this check existed, so renumbering either now would break its ledger
mapping. Grandfathered deliberately; do not add to this list to silence a new
collision, renumber the unapplied migration instead.
